description: Reference definitions of the ERP scores of task T6: for each ERP CORE component, the canonical channel, the measurement window and the polarity of the published analysis (Kappenman et al. 2021, NeuroImage 225:117465; data OSF 10.18115/D5JW4R). The scores are computed by evoparam.models.classical: mean amplitude over the window; peak amplitude and latency of the local peak (3 samples on each side) of the component's polarity; 50 % fractional area latency of the area of the component's polarity, above zero. The same windows are used by validation/erpcore.py.
source: ERP CORE (Kappenman et al. 2021), measurement windows of the published analysis
